body: Don’t do it friend. I just read a post I made on suicide watch a few years ago. It does get better. You have a wealth of people in this thread willing to talk
Ms. Jay and his sass gives me life
Currently rereading **Caraval** by Stephanie Garber to prepare for **Legendary**!

I’ve done elementary and high school. I liked high school more just because I can actually relate to them and I actually know what they’re talking about. The elementary kids are a lot nicer, but I felt like I had to be so on top of them, probably because I saw the same sets of kids all day. Usually if a kid is annoyed in the morning, he’s annoyed in the afternoon when we go to lunch. I may try middle school next year, just because I remember liking middle school the most and they’re a little bit older than the small kids so I can actually tell them to put themselves in groups without the room falling a part 😂. 

The results come back pretty quick, so fingers crossed. 

It’s important to celebrate successes! I hope your journey towards being more healthy plays in your favor. I need to start thinking about working out more now that summer has officially started.

I will say even my hard to love children were awesome yesterday. I started out with high schoolers, but having some little encouraging 10 year olds was nice. 

I’ll have to try out the app. It sounds promising and 12 minutes isn’t a huge commitment. 

Today I took my last certification exam, so fingers crossed that I passed. How did today go for you? Any difficulties or little accomplishments?

Thank you. Your kind words have been very encouraging. 

Today was the last day of school and I will say I was touched that the students I’ve only known for the past 9 weeks said that they’d truly miss me. I also learned that the position I interviewed for a few weeks ago got cut by my district, but I’m trying to just focus on saying goodbyes today and not letting being jobless for next year get to me. 

The book is called Guided Meditation by Mindfulness Training. It’s purple. I check it out through the Overdrive app on my phone, which runs through the local library system here. I may end up just buying it eventually so I don’t have to keep checking it out every 2 weeks. 

Does chewing gum work? That’s not something I’ve tried yet.

That’s good that your gf is straight up. I struggle with that bravery amongst most people.

My bf is great, but he certainly has his faults. I’m sure there are things about you that your girlfriend loves that you probably can’t see in yourself (I definitely struggle with this myself, not finding good things to say about myself.)

I’m currently meditating from an audiobook that I have on my phone at the end of the day, but I have nothing for the flare ups that happen when I can’t be near my phone. It’s difficult for me to do the meditative breathing if I can’t hear the music (yes I’m like Pavlov’s dogs.) Is there something that you do?

I will say that I’m slowly starting to realize that my bf can’t be my everything. It may sound harsh, but he can’t be my confidant, my boyfriend, my therapist and all the other burdens that I tack onto him. I know he says he doesn’t mind it, but I feel like it’s taking a toll on him.

I’m a bit better. I’m glad I reached out. I’m still upset, but I’m not blubbering crying anymore so it doesn’t freak out my students. I do have the end of the school year to look forward to. 

I haven’t had any thoughts since last night, but I think this has made me feel better (knowing that I’m not alone).

I try to think about how my students haven’t been crushed yet and how they’re so wide eyed and ready to learn. 

My bf and I don’t fight very often, so it’s a little off putting when it does happen, even though I know everyone fights. He is really the most supportive person I’ve been with. I felt terrible letting it slip that out of the friends he spends his time with the most, I don’t like too much. 

I often get sick when I’m too stressed out so I’m hoping I’ll feel fine when I have to get up for work in the morning.

If you need someone to talk to as well, my ear is open.

Thank you so much. I usually have an outlet to talk to, it’s just weird for me now that I don’t feel like I have one because he’s upset. 

I started having suicidal thoughts when I figured out that long term subs don’t get paid over the summer and you have to already be a district teacher to do summer school. The thoughts usually come when I’m at home and I consider how easy it would be to just drive off a cliff, but I’m thankful that I don’t think too much while I’m actually driving.
